title: 18-month-old girl with a runny nose
arrival: An 18-month-old girl is brought in by her mother with a runny nose for two days.
keyCriterion: High-risk vital sign — RR 46 breaths/min (threshold >40 for ages 1–4 years)
feedbackWhy: This patient does not meet any red or yellow criteria. However, her respiratory rate is above the high-risk threshold of 40 breaths/min for children aged 1–4 years. She should not be moved directly to the low-acuity or waiting area without immediate review by a supervising clinician. The supervising clinician or local protocol should determine her final triage category.
reviewNote: CLINICIAN REVIEW REQUIRED: confirm RR 46 is consistent with no chest indrawing and a runny nose only. Age band 1-4 years (HR 80-160, RR 20-40). Every value is proposed.

design.intendedChallenge: A child can look well and meet no red or yellow criterion yet have a high-risk vital sign for her age. The respiratory rate must be compared with the age band.
design.expectedCommonError: triaging as green because nothing is found before the vital signs step.

unresponsive.text: Awake. Looks around and reaches for her mother.

airway_red.text: No stridor. No chest indrawing. No central cyanosis.

circulation_red.text: Pulse strong. Extremities warm. Capillary refill 2 seconds. No bleeding. Awake and interacting. Eyes not sunken. Skin pinch returns at once. Drinking normally.

disability_red.text: No convulsions. Awake and interacting. Not confused, restless or irritable. No stiff neck.

other_red.text: No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or snake bite.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: Drinking and feeding normally. No vomiting or diarrhoea. Not pale. Mouth moist.

disability_yellow.text: Awake and interacting. Not restless or irritable. No severe pain.

other_yellow.text: No visible wasting. No swelling of both feet. No rash. No trauma. No known surgical diagnosis.
